decisions.reason: Certified gasketed plate exchangers for HVAC sit very close to the core offer, so keeping them on the market costs little while their uptake is still unclear after one year.
Early signals of a strong market share in water cooling show that this option is already paying off and justifies further commitment.
A dedicated page and close ties to the marine box cooler line make this a cheap option worth holding while marine demand is still revealing itself.
The compact oil cooler has received only a brief mention and its value is still uncertain, but holding it is inexpensive within a broad portfolio, so the option stays open for now.
Finned tubes are a component for the firm's own air coolers, so the option has low carrying cost and offers synergies across the range.
Enhanced tubes extend the R&D-backed core, carry little cost to keep, and still have upside potential, so abandoning them would be premature.
